title: Ntshungu Lowu Nyamalala
intro: U yima emahlweni ka swichayachayana swa vaaki lava xitori xa vona xi tsariweke hi magandlati. Mimoya-xiviri leyi yi twe xirhambo, yi hlawula ku kaneta, naswona yi langutane ni vuyelo lebyi vumbeke misava hi vuntshwa. I vamani, naswona ku humelele yini hi misava ya vona?
clues: Hi hanye khale swinene, kutani murhumiwa u tile eka hina a huma exikarhi ka hina.
A hi gandzela swifaniso swa ntlhanu hi tlhela hi ala ku swi tshika.
Hi hlekile murhumiwa loyi hi tlhela hi n’wi hehla hi ku va a hambukile.
Hi lave leswaku a tisa nxupulo loko a vula ntiyiso.
Hi vone matilo ma chulula mpfula naswona misava yi khuluka swihlovo.
Hi khandziye hi ya etindhawini leti tlakukeke leswaku hi baleka, kambe magandlati ma hi tlulerile.

arabic: قَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا
verse: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss. (71:21)
